ejectOnlyDescription.zh: 该组件主要配合 <link> 中的 wrap/eject 使用 ，与 MDX 里直接导入使用的组件不同，你可以通过传递组件 props 或直接覆盖该组件达到修改样式和功能的目的。如果通过 eject 覆盖整个组件，需注意组件对应配置项的读取会失效，需要自行控制。
ejectOnlyDescription.en: This component is mainly used in conjunction with wrap/eject in <link>, and is different from components that are directly imported in MDX. You can modify the styles and functions by passing component props or directly overriding the component. If you override the entire component through eject, please note that the reading of the corresponding configuration options of the component will become invalid and you need to control it yourself.

nonEjectableDescription.zh: 该组件目前暂不支持 <link> 通过 eject 命令复制源码。
nonEjectableDescription.en: This component currently does not support copying source code via the eject command.

bannerMessage.zh: ✨ 用 rspress-custom-theme skill 轻松定制 Rspress 主题
bannerMessage.en: ✨ Easily customize Rspress themes with the rspress-custom-theme skill

homeSsgMdTitle.zh:
人看 HTML，
AI 读 Markdown
homeSsgMdTitle.en:
HTML for humans,
Markdown for AI

homeSsgMdDesc.zh: 同一份源文件，两套产物。每个页面既是给人阅读的 HTML（SSG），也是给大语言模型的 Markdown 副本（SSG-MD），并遵循 llms.txt 规范生成站点级索引与全文。
homeSsgMdDesc.en: One source, two outputs. Every page is built as a fast HTML page for readers (SSG) and a clean Markdown twin for LLMs (SSG-MD), with site-wide llms.txt and llms-full.txt following the llms.txt standard.

homeSsgMdPoint1.zh: 每个页面都有 .md 副本，URL 中 .html 换成 .md 即可访问
homeSsgMdPoint1.en: Every page gets a .md twin — swap .html for .md in the URL

homeSsgMdPoint2.zh: 按导航结构生成 llms.txt 索引与 llms-full.txt 全文
homeSsgMdPoint2.en: llms.txt index and llms-full.txt, ordered by your navigation

homeSsgMdPoint3.zh: MDX 组件渲染为干净的 Markdown，而非语法噪音
homeSsgMdPoint3.en: MDX components render to clean Markdown, not syntax noise

homeNavTitle.zh: 导航与侧边栏，自动生成

homeNavDesc.zh: 在内容旁边声明导航结构：Rspress 通过 _nav.json 和 _meta.json 生成导航栏与侧边栏，并支持热更新，结构调整即时生效。
homeNavDesc.en: Declare the navbar and sidebar next to your content. Rspress generates them from _nav.json and _meta.json — with hot reload, so structure changes show up instantly.

homeNavPoint1.zh: _nav.json 生成导航栏，各目录 _meta.json 生成侧边栏

homeNavPoint2.zh: 支持排序、标签、图标、分组标题、分隔线与自定义链接
homeNavPoint2.en: Order, labels, icons, section headers, dividers and custom links

homeNavPoint3.zh: 页面元信息写在 frontmatter 中，与内容放在一起
homeNavPoint3.en: Page metadata stays in frontmatter, next to the content

homeExtendTitle.zh: 扩展构建流程，定制主题外观
homeExtendTitle.en: Extend the build, shape the theme

homeExtendDesc.zh: 通过插件机制介入构建的每个阶段，主题则可以从 CSS 变量一路定制到完全弹出的组件源码。
homeExtendDesc.en: Hook into every stage with the plugin system, and tailor the look from CSS variables to fully ejected components.

homeExtendPoint1.zh: 官方插件覆盖搜索、Sitemap、API 文档、组件预览等场景
homeExtendPoint1.en: Official plugins for search, sitemap, API docs, previews and more

homeExtendPoint2.zh: 主题定制：CSS 变量、布局插槽，或 rspress eject 弹出源码
homeExtendPoint2.en: Theme via CSS variables, layout slots, or rspress eject
